GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree (and subpackages), which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release. Scout matches golang.org/x/crypto at the module level because the advisory records the module with no fixed version. The golang-msft-fips toolchain is built from microsoft/go; repository code search shows no import of golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp under src/cmd or elsewhere in src. go.mod lists golang.org/x/crypto as a bootstrap module dependency, but the openpgp subpackage is not compiled into the shipped go/compiler binaries (vulnerable_code_not_present).

GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree (and subpackages), which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release. Scout matches golang.org/x/crypto at the module level because the advisory records the module with no fixed version. go tool nm on the shipped docker-scout, docker-buildx, docker-compose, and docker cli binaries found no import or link of golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp; scout's sigstore/rekor dependency was bumped to v1.5.4 so rekor PGP verification uses github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/openpgp instead. The vulnerable OpenPGP code is therefore not present in the shipped artifacts (vulnerable_code_not_present).
